import subprocess

# Test m2: footnote handling
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', '''
import markdown
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "footnotes"])
text = "# Header with footnote[^1]\n\n[^1]: text"
result = md.convert(text)
print("Result:")
print(result[:500])
print()
print("TOC:", md.toc)
print()
print("TOC tokens:", md.toc_tokens)

# Check TOC link text
from xml.etree.ElementTree import fromstring
root = fromstring(md.toc)
for a in root.iter("a"):
    print(f"TOC anchor text: {repr(a.text)}")
    assert a.text == "Header with footnote", f"Expected 'Header with footnote', got {repr(a.text)}"
print("Footnote test OK!")
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
if result.returncode != 0:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr)
